Where does your fade start?

The menu is built around one question. Answer it and you'll book the right cut, at the right price, with the right time set aside.

SkinFull length
SkinZeroFadeClassic

  1. Skin Fade

    Starts at the skin with a foil shaver. Scissor cut or buzz on top.

    from$5540 min+

  2. Zero Fade

    Starts at 0, clipper with no guard. Scissor cut or buzz on top.

    $5530 min+

  3. Fade Cut

    Starts on a guard. Not from zero, not from skin.

    from$4530 min+

  4. Classic Cut

    No fade. Short back and sides on the clipper, scissors on top.

    $4420 min

After a taper with a texture top, or a mullet? Both have their own line on the menu below, and so does a mostly-scissor cut.

Every cut, every price.

Straight from the booking system. Where a price depends on length or the barber, you'll see the range, and Square confirms the exact figure before you book.

The shop

“Every barber earns by their own work, so they'll give you the perfect haircut, every single time.”

The shop's own words, on Instagram

Gilt mirrors, chipboard walls, gold capes and a seven-year-old Wahl Magic Clip that still refuses to slow down. Nobody here is on the clock to rush you out of the chair.

Every barber works to the same standard of care and detail. So if your usual barber has no spot, choose Any Staff on the booking screen and take the next free chair.

You might have seen the team before: they ran a barber station at Hop Temple for the Ballarat Beard Comp.
